Location

How to get there

The best way to access Silverworks Island is by using the Elizabeth Line to Custom House. The site is a short walk from Custom House Station via Victoria Dock Road.

There is no parking available at the venue. Road closures and parking restrictions will be in force in the local area. Do not drive to the venue.

  • Address

    Royal Victoria Dock,
    Silvertown Square
    Connaught Bridge,
    N Woolwich Rd,
    London
    E16 2BU

  • BY LONDON OVERGROUND AND TRAINS

    The best way to access Silverworks Island is by using the Elizabeth Line to Custom House. The Elizabeth Line provides a frequent high capacity train service via Custom House which is a short walk from the venue.

    We will be running a shuttle bus service between Canning Town Station and the site in order to provide direct connectivity to the Jubilee Line. Shuttle bus tickets are available for purchase via Kaboodle. We advise booking in advance to secure your seat. Tickets will be available on the day for £3.50 each way on a first come first served basis.

  • BY TAXI

    Please use our designated drop-off and pick-up point at Dockside Car Park, Dockside Road, London E16 2QT.

  • BY AIR

    Flying in? London City Airport is just a 3-minute drive from Silverworks Island, connecting you to major UK and European cities like Amsterdam, Dublin, Edinburgh, Berlin, and Manchester.
